scope.commit_binding: containing immutable payload commit supplied by handoff

producer.update_bound: At most the complete required artifact population per family, after actual affected-set analysis; never regenerate unaffected artifacts to consume a quota.
producer.correction: At most one additional production packet per required artifact in this allocation; concrete defect and new linked attempt required.

review.binding: Both judges receive the identical exact candidate and criterion set. A batch is a bounded review task, not an authority or a substitute for the full layer barrier.
review.oversize_rule: Never truncate decisive evidence. Partition before dispatch within the session total and protected correction pool, record the derived IDs; if the reserved capacity is insufficient, BLOCKED before dispatch and request a new S1 allocation.

consumer.isolation: One case per bounded consumer packet; actual host isolation and tool/source restrictions must be reported. Review batching does not share oracle answers with consumers.

transport_ref.commit_binding: containing immutable payload commit supplied by handoff

consumer.oracle: S5 freezes concrete question/mutation, expected reasoning, consequences, decisive evidence and critical errors before evaluation. Current public cases are ORACLE_PENDING.

oracle_authoring.basis: One bounded preparation packet per domain or cross-domain flow; no inference of oracle completion.

recovery.basis: initial implementation/evidence, one concrete correction, one focused recheck; controls are requirements, not executions

host.basis: initial implementation/evidence, one concrete correction, one focused recheck; preserve more precise S4 cases

barriers: complete L1 accepted by both judges before dependent L2
accepted output plus actual governed admission before published consumption
activation: No production activation authorized by this plan. Native authoring within the known host guarantee, product conformance and publication are distinct.
completion: This is a finite capacity plan, not evidence that any listed production, consumer or control has run.
